code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in g))
    # separator is a solid horizontal line of a non-background color
    sep=next(r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg)
    sepcolor=g[sep][0]
    # find non-background, non-separator object bounding box
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and not (r==sep and g[r][c]==sepcolor)]
    top=min(r for r,c in pts); bot=max(r for r,c in pts)
    left=min(c for r,c in pts); right=max(c for r,c in pts)
    obj=[row[left:right+1] for row in g[top:bot+1]]
    above=bot<sep
    newtop=sep-len(obj) if above else sep+1
    # clear old object cells
    for r,c in pts:g[r][c]=bg
    for i,row in enumerate(obj):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            if v!=bg:g[newtop+i][left+j]=v
    marker=newtop-1 if above else newtop+len(obj)
    if 0<=marker<h:g[marker]=[8]*w
    return g
'''
